pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with soft, smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patches on the upper neck are smaller in spatial area and vertically elongated, while flank patches are larger with more complex, multi-angled boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space graph is formed by light-toned, continuous pathways. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent, where three patches meet. The pixel thickness of these corridors remains relatively uniform across the visible torso and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck. The contour is distinctly visible against the blurred background, showing a consistent textural frequency from mid-neck to the shoulder.
